title.narrative: Promoting Gender Equality via the Network of Solidarity Academies

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to establish a national network which will bring Solidarity Academies studying gender together with CSOs working in women and LGBTI rights. Specific objectives are . Strengthening the organisational and institutional capacity of the network Improving the networks capacity on tackling the challenges of the political environment on gender studies and gender equalitySupporting blended studies on gender equality generated by the network members to share their experience and knowledge with CSOs working in the field of women rights and LGBTI+ rights.
